stem: Which set contains variables used by the RNLE to characterize a lifting task?
choices: Load weight, hand locations, travel distance, asymmetry, frequency, duration, and coupling quality
Worker age, body weight, job title, years employed, and preferred lifting style
Room temperature, humidity, light intensity, irrigation volume, and bench height
Container color, crop stage, shift name, supervisor ratio, and route length
rationale: NIOSH identifies load, hand geometry, vertical travel, asymmetry, frequency, duration/rest, and coupling among the key RNLE inputs.
